name: new-suspend-mode
description: Decky Loader plugin that replaces the SteamOS sleep with a controller-aware standby, with downloads carrying on in the background.

scripts.package: shx rm -rf build NewSuspendMode.zip && shx mkdir -p build/NewSuspendMode && shx cp -r dist plugin.json main.py package.json assets build/NewSuspendMode/ && cd build && zip -r ../NewSuspendMode.zip NewSuspendMode && cd ..
